name: Sigurd
subtitle: Dragons Bane
description: Quintessential Brawler that dishes out big damage when taking damage.
lore: Sigurd is most famous as a dragon-slayer, but his greatest challenge lay in the jealous machinations of Brynhild. Any relief Sigurd may find from those schemes since the Shattering, however, is tempered by the return of Fafnir the dragon. Sigurd takes the reversal of his greatest triumph as a personal affront, and seeks to regain his former glory at any cost.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy
